tagline: Sync Salesforce account data to Notion wikis so your team always has current customer context
metaTitle: Salesforce Notion Integration: Customer Wikis from Deals
metaDescription: Generate Notion customer wikis from closed-won deals and log meeting notes back to Salesforce. GAIA keeps account data in sync. See the setup steps.
intro:
Salesforce holds your company's most valuable customer data, but it's structured for CRM workflows rather than human reading. Account managers who need to understand a customer's history, product teams who need to know what features were promised in a deal, and onboarding teams who need to brief themselves on a new account all struggle to extract the knowledge they need from the field-heavy interface.

GAIA bridges the CRM and Notion by automatically generating readable, organized knowledge from the structured account data. When an opportunity closes, GAIA creates a customer wiki with the deal details, key contacts, and committed deliverables. When account data changes, the corresponding page updates automatically.

For customer success, solutions engineering, and product teams, this integration turns Salesforce from a system of record into a source of readable, actionable knowledge that everyone can access in the tool they use every day.

useCases.title: Auto-generate customer wikis from Closed Won deals
useCases.description: When an opportunity is marked Closed Won, GAIA creates a structured page for the new customer including account details, key contacts, deal terms, and a blank onboarding checklist.

useCases.title: Sync account health data to Notion dashboards
useCases.description: GAIA pulls Salesforce account health indicators — renewal date, ARR, product tier, support tier — into a database so your customer success team has a live dashboard without toggling between tools.

useCases.title: Create meeting prep pages from Salesforce opportunities
useCases.description: Before an opportunity reaches a key stage, GAIA creates a meeting prep page with the opportunity history, contact information, and previous meeting notes, so your AE walks in fully briefed.

useCases.title: Log meeting notes back to Salesforce activities
useCases.description: When a meeting note is finalized in Notion, GAIA creates a corresponding activity log on the relevant opportunity or account record, keeping the CRM up to date without requiring the AE to double-enter information.

useCases.title: Update Notion product feedback database from opportunity notes
useCases.description: GAIA scans opportunity notes and call logs for product feedback mentions and adds them to a product feedback database, giving product teams a structured view of what customers are requesting.

howItWorks.step: Connect Notion and Salesforce to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate your Notion workspace and Salesforce org in GAIA's settings. Specify which objects (Accounts, Opportunities, Contacts) should sync to which databases.

howItWorks.step: Configure sync triggers and field mappings
howItWorks.description: Define which CRM events create or update pages, how CRM fields map to page properties, and which database changes should write back to activities.

howItWorks.step: GAIA turns CRM data into accessible knowledge
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors the CRM for the triggers you've configured and automatically creates or updates the corresponding pages, ensuring your team always has current customer context in a readable format.

faqs.question: Can GAIA pull custom Salesforce fields into Notion?
faqs.answer: Yes. During setup GAIA reads your object schema including custom fields and objects, allowing you to map any CRM data to page properties in your database.

faqs.question: Is the sync back to the CRM real-time or periodic?
faqs.answer: CRM-to-page sync is event-driven and near real-time. Page-to-CRM sync (e.g., logging meeting notes) can be triggered manually by the user or automatically when a page reaches a specified status.

faqs.question: Does GAIA expose sensitive CRM data to unauthorized workspace members?
faqs.answer: GAIA writes to the pages and databases you designate and respects the existing permission model. If a page is restricted to specific members, only those members can view the CRM-derived content.

faqs.question: Can multiple account records map to a single page?
faqs.answer: Yes. For customers with multiple account records (e.g., parent and child accounts), GAIA can consolidate the relevant data into a single page or create linked child pages, depending on your configured structure.
